import csv
import io

from shelf import books


def dump(author=None):
    rows = books.all_books()
    if author is not None:
        rows = [b for b in rows if b["author"] == author]
    out = io.StringIO()
    w = csv.DictWriter(out, fieldnames=["title", "author"], lineterminator="\n")
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(rows)
    return out.getvalue()
